interface.title: Promoter Screen Explorer
interface.field: Gene therapy / synthetic biology: promoter screening across cell lines (in vitro) and mouse tissues (in vivo)
interface.stage_of_work: Reviewing and planning experiments: looking back over past screening results to choose candidates and find gaps in coverage
interface.what_it_is_for: Shows which promoters have been tested in which cell lines and tissues and how strongly each one expressed relative to the CTRL-POS reference promoter, with QC flags you can switch on and off so that every chart recalculates.

data.note: A synthetic demo dataset (labelled 'Synthetic demo data', generated by scripts/generate_data.py) loads automatically. It covers 38 promoters (CTRL-POS, CTRL-NEG, SP-001 to SP-036) in 6 families, 7 in vitro contexts (HEK293, HeLa, HepG2, C2C12 myotubes, Neuro-2a, iPSC myotubes, iPSC neurons) and 4 in vivo tissues (Liver, Quadriceps, Heart, Brain) at Weeks 2, 4 and 8. It has 5 QC flag types; 88 records are excluded by default. Nothing was uploaded.

tree.general: Decide which candidate regulatory elements to take forward, and where more experiments are needed, based on past screening results whose quality varies
tree.specific: Use the promoter × context screen results, measured relative to CTRL-POS, to shortlist promoters and plan new experiments, checking that conclusions hold without QC-flagged records

features.name: Coverage matrix with four-state cells
features.general: A grid of items × conditions that shows measured value by colour and tells apart never measured, measured but all rejected, and partly rejected. Hover gives the value, n and source; clicking a row opens that item's detail.
features.specific: Promoter × context heatmap with a diverging colour scale (32× weaker to 32× stronger vs CTRL-POS), dashed cells for not tested, hatched cells for all records QC-excluded and black borders for some records excluded. It has a Contexts count column, a tooltip with fold change, n, excluded count and source experiment, and opens the profile on click.
steps: Scan the colours and legend
Hover a cell to read fold change, n and source experiment
Spot dashed (untested) versus hatched (all QC-failed) cells
Click a row or cell to open that promoter's profile
serves_tasks: Read the overall coverage map and tell never-measured combinations apart from measured-but-all-rejected ones
Check whether one specific candidate has already been measured in a given cell type or tissue before planning a new experiment
Open one item's full profile from the overview

features.name: Shared filter bar (family, ID search, time point)
features.general: Global filters that narrow the item list and pick which time point the in vivo data come from, applied to every view
features.specific: Family dropdown, Search box (for example 'SP-02') and In vivo timepoint (Week 2/4/8) above all tabs. They filter the matrix rows and the profile's Promoter dropdown, and set the in vivo values used in Coverage, Profile and Compare.
steps: Choose a family
Type an ID fragment in Search
Choose the in vivo time point
Watch the matrix, profile and comparison titles and values update
serves_tasks: Narrow the map to the items of interest
Switch the time point used for the in vivo measurements
Look at the in vivo results at a different time point

features.name: Single-item profile: bars vs reference, untested list and flag table
features.general: A detail page for one item: a mean ± SD bar chart relative to a reference line, chips naming the conditions never measured, and a table of every flagged record with its current included/excluded status
features.specific: Promoter profile: horizontal log2-vs-CTRL-POS bars with SD whiskers and hover tooltips, the 'Not yet tested in' chips, and 'QC flags on this promoter' (Source, Context, Record, Flag, Status), with 'Add to comparison' and 'Export PNG'
steps: Choose a promoter (from the matrix or the dropdown)
Hover bars for fold change and n
Read the untested contexts
Check which flagged records are included or excluded
Send the promoter to Compare or export the chart
serves_tasks: Compare the candidate's signal with the reference in every context where it was measured
List the contexts where the candidate was never measured, and the flagged records behind its numbers
Send a candidate from its detail page into the comparison set

features.name: Capped multi-item grouped bar comparison
features.general: Pick up to N items as removable chips and toggle which conditions appear. A grouped bar chart with error bars, a shared-group tooltip and a note listing missing combinations lets you rank the items.
features.specific: Compare promoters: colour-coded chips with × and a '+ add promoter' dropdown that disappears at 6; context toggle chips; grouped log2-vs-CTRL-POS bars with SD error bars; a hover tooltip listing each promoter's fold change; and a 'No QC-passing data: …' footnote
steps: Add promoters (from a profile or the add dropdown) up to 6
Remove any with ×
Toggle context chips
Hover a context group to read fold changes
Read the footnote for combinations with no usable data
serves_tasks: Assemble up to six candidates and the conditions to compare them in
Pick the strongest performer in the target context

features.name: QC flag-type switchboard with live recalculation
features.general: A table of data-quality flag categories with record counts and affected items. Each has an include/exclude switch, and the whole app recomputes, so you can test how sensitive a conclusion is to questionable data.
features.specific: QC review: a row per flag (low_viability, transfection_failure, poor_differentiation, injection_issue, imaging_saturation) with meaning, in vitro and in vivo record counts, promoters affected and a 'Use in analysis' checkbox. The tab label shows the live excluded count, and Coverage cells, Profile bars and QC status, and Compare bars all update.
steps: Open QC review
Tick or untick a flag type
Watch the excluded count change
Go back to Coverage, Profile or Compare and compare values with and without the flag
serves_tasks: Switch categories of flagged records in or out of the analysis
See how one item's value changes when flagged records are let back in
See gaps caused only by rejected data fill in on the overview map
Re-check a shortlist ranking with and without flagged data

screens_never_reached: A separate 'Export' view/tab: the repository describes five views, but the app shows only four tabs (Coverage, Promoter profile, Compare, QC review). Export exists only as an 'Export PNG' button on each panel.
not_done: Could not check that the exported PNGs are 'high-resolution'. The browser reports only their byte sizes (coverage-matrix.png 201,620 B; SP-013-profile.png 108,152 B), not their pixel size.
Did not toggle the low_viability flag (3 in vitro records, 1 promoter); the other four flag types were tested.
Did not try a narrow or phone window, keyboard navigation, or the Control family filter.
No task reads in vitro and in vivo columns separately (e.g. 'tested in cells but never in animals'), although the matrix groups its columns that way.
Matrix cell tooltips are browser titles, so their values (e.g. SP-006 Brain in screens/033.webp) are not visible in screenshots; values come from the run's hover readout.
No Week 4 screenshot was kept for SP-024 Liver, so whether its some-excluded border appears only at Week 8 is not shown; the replay saw no border appear or disappear when switching time points.

Observed limitations, not failures: (1) Compare's context chips reset to the default set (HEK293, iPSC myotubes, iPSC neurons, Quadriceps, Brain) each time you leave and return to the Compare tab, though the chosen promoters persist (screens/027.webp, screens/031.webp). (2) Removing a promoter reassigns series colours by position (screens/014.webp). (3) The 'No QC-passing data' footnote lists untested and all-QC-failed combinations together without telling them apart. (4) On the profile, an all-QC-failed context (e.g. SP-028 Neuro-2a) is left out of both the chart and 'Not yet tested in', and shows only in the QC flag table (screens/019.webp). (5) Matrix column headers do not sort (screens/034.webp).
